name: 08 - Operations Hub Review and Local Demo

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body&&typeof $json.body==='object'&&!Array.isArray($json.body)?$json.body:$json;const errors=[];const id=typeof body.requestDbId==='string'?body.requestDbId.trim():'';const decision=typeof body.decision==='string'?body.decision.trim().toLowerCase():'';const reviewer=typeof body.reviewer==='string'?body.reviewer.trim():'';if(!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id))errors.push('requestDbId must be a UUID');if(!['approved','rejected'].includes(decision))errors.push('decision must be approved or rejected');if(reviewer.length<2||reviewer.length>120)errors.push('reviewer must contain 2 to 120 characters');for(const key of Object.keys(body))if(!['requestDbId','decision','reviewer','revisionNotes'].includes(key))errors.push('unknown field: '+key);const revisionNotes=typeof body.revisionNotes==='string'?body.revisionNotes.trim().slice(0,1000):'';return[{json:{valid:errors.length===0,errors,requestDbId:id,decision,reviewer,revisionNotes}}];

parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS doc),
changed AS (
  UPDATE project_blueprints pb SET approval_status=payload.doc->>'decision',approved_at=NOW(),approved_by=payload.doc->>'reviewer',updated_at=NOW()
  FROM payload WHERE pb.request_id=(payload.doc->>'requestDbId')::uuid AND pb.approval_status='pending'
  RETURNING pb.request_id,pb.solution_blueprint,pb.risk_review,pb.effort_estimate,pb.approval_status,pb.approved_at,pb.approved_by
),
state_updated AS (
  UPDATE project_requests request SET status=changed.approval_status,updated_at=NOW() FROM changed WHERE request.id=changed.request_id RETURNING request.id
),
audited AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events(request_id,event_type,actor,details)
  SELECT changed.request_id,CASE changed.approval_status WHEN 'approved' THEN 'operations-hub.approved' ELSE 'operations-hub.rejected' END,changed.approved_by,jsonb_build_object('decision',changed.approval_status,'revisionNotes',NULLIF(payload.doc->>'revisionNotes',''),'executionGate',false,'localOnly',true)
  FROM changed CROSS JOIN payload RETURNING id
)
SELECT payload.doc->>'requestDbId' AS request_db_id,COALESCE(changed.approval_status,'not-found-or-already-reviewed') AS status,payload.doc->>'reviewer' AS reviewer,changed.approved_at,changed.solution_blueprint,changed.risk_review,changed.effort_estimate,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audited)::int AS audit_events_written FROM payload LEFT JOIN changed ON TRUE;

parameters.jsCode: const row=$json;const found=['approved','rejected'].includes(row.status);const approved=row.status==='approved';const blueprint=row.solution_blueprint?.data??row.solution_blueprint??{};const proposal=approved?{recordType:'local-demo-execution-draft',companyScope:blueprint.companyScope??'',proposedIntegrations:(blueprint.integrations??[]).map(item=>item.system),proposedSteps:(blueprint.processingSteps??[]).map(step=>({order:step.order,name:step.name})),requiresAdditionalConfirmationBeforeExternalAction:true,synthetic:true}:null;return[{json:{ok:found,status:found?(approved?'approved-local-draft-prepared':'rejected-blocked'):'not-found-or-already-reviewed',requestDbId:row.request_db_id??null,reviewer:row.reviewer??null,auditEventsWritten:Number(row.audit_events_written??0),executionGate:false,localDemo:approved?{status:'prepared',proposal,externalActions:{crmWrites:0,tasksCreated:0,messagesSent:0}}:{status:'blocked',proposal:null,externalActions:{crmWrites:0,tasksCreated:0,messagesSent:0}},errors:found?[]:['No pending blueprint was found for this request.']} }];
